static_traits.name: Li Kai婷
static_traits.medical_history: without明显躯体疾病；既往without类似心理问题与心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 态度积极，表达清晰，逻辑性较好，能进行自我Reflection，配合度高

basic_info.main_problem: Because I spent time reading car-related books, I feel obvious guilt, and this guilt has affected my motivation and self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize this guilt affects my mental health and my enjoyment of hobbies I once loved, so I seek counseling; I want to enjoy my hobbies again and improve my overall well-being.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on whether I use time on 'more important / more productive' things
把时间花在个人兴趣上是自私的，会让我成为not称职的Mother/妻子

special_situations.event: A few days ago, while reading a new book about engine systems
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I spend time on personal interests rather than more productive things or being with family, I am letting my family down
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets a strict timetable, limits car-related reading, and forces themselves to turn time toward things deemed 'more useful'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should be doing something more productive/should be with my children; doing this is selfish of me

special_situations.event: Several times a week, when she takes time to read car books alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 个人休闲应当让位于家庭责任，否则就意味着我是个not称职的Mother/妻子
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 缩短或取消阅读时间，优先安排家务与育儿以Undoing内疚
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在辜负他们，I am not good enough

special_situations.event: After work, faces the dual pressure of work and family, when needing to choose between rest and companionship
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: not是把全部时间用于工作和家庭就是失败，have not中间地带
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets high standards and tight plans for oneself, reducing personal time to maintain a 'qualified' image
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not可以放松，一放松就是not负责任

special_situations.event: At night before sleep回想当天曾花时间阅读而have not持续陪伴家人时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有把时间最大化用于家庭与“正事”才算称职，其他收获都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在心里negate当日与家人的高质量相处，用自我批评来驱动第二天更少休闲
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 今天又not把时间用在该做的事上，我在失败

core_conflict.wish: 在承担工作与家庭责任的同时，仍被允许并被接纳地享受个人兴趣与自我时间，且依然被视为“好Mother/好妻子”
core_conflict.fear: 一旦满足自我兴趣会被视为自私与not称职，伤害家人关系并遭到批评或拒绝
defense_goal: Maintains the image of a 'qualified caregiver' through self-criticism and raising inner standards
Repression个人兴趣与需求以降低被指责的风险
以严密计划与过度责任感来缓解内疚与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 内疚而自责的照料者，需要not断牺牲自我来证明自己是“好人/好Mother”
object_relations.object_representation: Family/others who might be hurt or disappointed by me; they will judge me because I focus on myself

object_relations.self_representation: 有真实兴趣与需要被允许的个体
object_relations.object_representation: Internalized 'judge / moral judge' (rules and expectations of society / family)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the topic involves the legitimacy of setting aside personal time for oneself or enjoying reading
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识把允许自我等同为对家人的伤害，担心被视为自私与not称职（移情：将内在“评判者”的目光Projection到重要他人身上）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气克制且自我苛责，频繁use“我应该/我not该”句式，弱化自身需要以维持被接纳感。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当感到放松或投入于个人爱好后想起not yet完成的家庭/工作任务时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把内在Anxiety理解为“事实证明我做错了”，认为他人会因此失望或责备自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 强调责任与效率，以“更有生产力”为理由negate个人兴趣的价值，语气紧绷、带有自责。

manifestations: 在个人选择（阅读兴趣）与角色责任（Mother/妻子/员工）之间体验两难与内在冲突
Replacing self-choice with heteronomous 'should/must' standards, difficult to give oneself permission
outcomes: 难以放松与享受兴趣，Decline in sense of well-being
睡眠被干扰、易怒与Relationship tension

manifestations: 虽有支持性的配偶，但not yet向其表达真实内疚体验
In the family, replaces real communication with self-demands and emotionally isolates herself
outcomes: 缺乏外部支持以调节情绪，问题维持

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁use“我应该/必须更有生产力、应该陪孩子”等自我要求语句
以外在角色标准评判自我价值，negate个人兴趣的正当性

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复自我批评“I am not good enough / incompetent”
担心被评价而收缩个人时间与需求

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: have not与配偶沟通真实感受与需要，而是通过限制阅读来对自己施加控制
把想向外寻求理解与支持的需求转向自我Repression

positive_force: Has genuine interest and intrinsic motivation in automotive mechanics; can gain satisfaction from learning
配偶被描述为支持性资源
自我觉察Good且愿意寻求帮助，合作态度积极
工作表现not yet受影响，具备稳定的角色功能
Usually also has quality time with family, with a potential foundation for balance
negative_force: Intense 'should/must' rules and perfected role standards
倾向negate积极证据与自我成就（Disqualifying the Positive）
自我批评与内疚感强，外部评价导向
Avoids expressing inner experience to significant others, leading to absent support
Sleep disturbed与压力负荷增加，进一步削弱情绪调节

target_behavior.behavior: Feels intense guilt and self-blame when doing personal reading (car-related) or thinking about setting aside time for himself
antecedent: 独自阅读汽车相关书籍时
下班后在家庭与个人时间之间做取舍时
临睡前回想当天花在兴趣上的时间
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化的外界规则与角色期望（“应该更有生产力/应该把时间给家人”），将自我关怀等同于自私与not称职
target_behavior.function: 通过自我批评与限制兴趣活动来逃避被指责与内疚的not适，维持“合格Mother/妻子”的自我形象
target_behavior.consequence: 难以享受兴趣、Decreased motivation、Strained relationships with family members、睡眠被打乱

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与配偶沟通内疚与真实需求
antecedent: 想到要谈及个人时间与兴趣的正当性时
在感到内疚或被自我评判压迫时
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心自我兴趣被评判为自私，害怕被negate或引发冲突
target_behavior.function: In the short term avoids shame and feelings of conflict, maintaining superficial harmony and self-image
target_behavior.consequence: 失去现实支持与Empathy，情绪累积，Relationship tensionnot yet解
